title: The CEO Who Sold 'Forever' Batteries—They Exploded After 2 Years

why_this_can_go_viral: Sounds like a Hollywood heist, but it's real—perfect for the 'impossible scenario' hook.

hook: They owned all the pharmacies in a hundred-mile radius, so if you needed a simple suture, you paid their price or bled.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into universal fear of medical exploitation and monopolies, sparking anger and discussion.

why_this_can_go_viral: Absurd but true method of espionage—viewers will share for the 'eww' factor and disbelief.

title: The Monopoly That Bought Every Water Bottler—Then Shrunk the Bottles by 1% Every Year

why_this_can_go_viral: Gross-out factor plus financial intrigue—viewers will be both disgusted and amazed at the audacity.
